_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Disbelief band with coil stats (rare ±2 moves); no breaker yet from F&G/funding/momentum expansion or vol+inflow flush, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on phase but inflow rise is cautionary/distribution-tilted, not a bullish disagree
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~48-62, funding near flat, 30d momentum fails to expand, and inflows do not cascade into sustained sell pressure
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >~65 with funding and momentum expanding together (up-rung), or vol spike plus continued exchange inflows breaks drift into Anxiety (down-rung)
